rv.q: Outrageously funny Mindelle plays Celine as an omniscient narrator who gloriously upstage everybody else.
The cast and creators' enthusiasm is infectious, and if you just let it wash over you, you'll have a boatload of fun.

Even if you have to beat a couple of Swedes in a portside game of poker for a ticket—and slum it in third-class—near, far, wherever you are, get yourself to New York’s Theatre to experience Titanique, a show so ridiculous that it is pure comedy genius.
As jokes land and jokes sink, there’s still the joy of hearing many of Dion’s greatest hits, a cavalcade of top-tier pop.
